findings.text: calibration/readme.md is now out of date. Its last bullet still says "Suggestions for the owner: /live/calibration/", but the page now shows each prompt's input and output. The old log, moved aside to `calibration/live-page-2026-11-07.jsonl`, is listed nowhere (Law 10: index everything).
calibration/results.md line 3 still says "The suggested tasks are on /live/calibration/". Those cards are gone (ask 3), so this sentence now sends a reader to something that no longer exists.

A fresh agent could not continue from this task folder alone. `task.jsonl` holds only the `shots` line: no opening line, no log, no worktree name (`worktree/calibration-page`) and no outcome. Only `requirements.md` explains the task.

/live/readme.md does not mention /live/calibration/ at all. That folder now holds a page.js and a stylesheet rather than a live log, so it differs from the pattern the readme describes and needs a line in Files (Law 11: readmes are the index).
Ask 1 wants "one line" at the top. It is a full paragraph: 4 lines at 1920 and 7 at 400 (shots/…/400.png, top band). Both links are there. A shorter sentence would do it.
Ask 2 wants the matched tasks linked. Every task link goes to the same session record (`SESSION`), not to the task itself. The links work, but none of them points at its own task.
At every width the console shows a 404 for a resource it does not name (layout.json `errors`). The page draws fine, but the missing file should be found.
At 3440 the content stops at 90em on the left and leaves the right of the screen empty (empty 0.779). That is fine for reading text, but it wastes the wide screen.
